cloud-monthly-credit.title: Monthly Google Cloud credit
cloud-monthly-credit.summary: Redeem in the Google Developer Program and apply the credit to a Cloud Billing account you can manage.
cloud-monthly-credit.eligibility: Eligible paid subscribers receive credits monthly from the date they first activate developer benefits.
steps: Open the benefits page with the selected subscription account and find the Google Cloud credits card.
Select the billing account, verify its name, and choose Apply.
To apply future credits automatically, choose Always use this billing account. Credits follow the monthly anniversary of the first activation.
In Cloud Billing, select that account and check the credit and expiration date.

cloud-free-trial.title: Google Cloud trial credit
cloud-free-trial.summary: Eligible new customers can apply for a one-time USD 300 credit, valid for up to 90 days.
cloud-free-trial.eligibility: Google Cloud verifies new-customer eligibility and which services are covered.
steps: Review trial eligibility and billing terms on the official Google page.
In Cloud Billing, check the trial account, credit amount, and expiration date.

colab-cu.title: Colab compute units
colab-cu.summary: Colab compute units are provided monthly. Ultra gives you longer background runtimes and access to more powerful GPUs.
colab-cu.eligibility: Google verifies eligible regions, age of 18 or over, and plan manager status. Refresh Colab to see the current balance and rate.
steps: Open Colab with the subscription account and verify the email address.
Connect that account in Google Perks Manager and refresh to see the live CU balance, usage rate, and running instances.

antigravity.title: Antigravity
antigravity.summary: Antigravity agent limits increase with the plan tier. The multipliers apply to Google's published baseline Gemini allowance.
antigravity.eligibility: Antigravity shows model limits and refresh windows for the signed-in account. Third-party models have their own limits.
steps: Sign in to Antigravity with the subscription account.
Check available models and limits in Antigravity, and any extra AI credits in Google One.

antigravity-carbon.title: Gemini 4 Carbon in Antigravity
antigravity-carbon.summary: Ultra personal plans include access to Gemini 4 Carbon in Antigravity.
antigravity-carbon.eligibility: Check available models and baseline usage in the signed-in Antigravity account.

flow.title: Google Flow video credits
flow.summary: The plan includes dedicated monthly Flow credits for generating images and video.
flow.eligibility: Check how many credits each model uses and when credits renew in Flow. Monthly plan credits reset each billing cycle.
steps: Open Flow with the selected account and check the plan and remaining allowance.
Review the credit balance and activity on Google One's AI credits page.

flow-low-priority.title: Low-priority generation in Flow
flow-low-priority.summary: Ultra 20x can generate video at low priority for selected models and resolutions.
flow-low-priority.eligibility: Zero-credit generation depends on the model, resolution, and account eligibility. Check the credit cost in Flow before submitting.

flow-4k-upscaling.title: 4K upscaling in Flow
flow-4k-upscaling.summary: Both Ultra tiers can upscale supported images and videos to 4K. Pro video upscaling goes up to 1080p.
flow-4k-upscaling.eligibility: Image and video upscaling have separate limits. Check the options and cost for the model shown in Flow.
steps: Open your work in Flow with your Ultra account. Look for 4K in the download or upscale options.
Check the available resolution and credit cost for your model. For example, upscaling a 1 to 10 second Gemini Omni Flash video to 4K uses 50 credits.

flow-music.title: Flow Music
flow-music.summary: The plan includes dedicated credits you can check in your Flow Music account.
flow-music.eligibility: Authorize the eligible subscription account. Music credits are tracked separately in Flow Music.
steps: In Flow Music, choose Continue with Google and verify your email address.
Review the requested membership permissions on the Google consent page, then check your credits in Flow Music.

storage.title: Google One cloud storage
storage.summary: Drive, Gmail, and Google Photos share the storage included in Google One.
storage.eligibility: Google AI Pro includes 5 TB or 10 TB depending on the plan. Check your total on the Google One storage page.
steps: Verify the account in Google One, then check its total and used storage.
Open the storage manager in Google One. On a supported mobile device, you can set up device backup through Google One.

gemini.title: Gemini
gemini.summary: Ultra increases Gemini usage allowances and gives access to more models than Pro.
gemini.eligibility: Usage multipliers use Pro as the baseline. Check the signed-in account for model, feature, and regional limits.
steps: Switch to the subscription account and check the models and features available in Gemini.
In Gemini, check your account for Deep Research, Gemini Live, video and music generation, and available models and limits. Daily Brief is currently US only.

notebook.title: Gemini Notebook
notebook.summary: Formerly NotebookLM. Subscriptions increase the limits for research, chat, and generating content.
notebook.eligibility: The table shows the number of sources per notebook, excluding notes. Chat, audio and video overviews have separate limits.
steps: Verify the email address signed in to Gemini Notebook.
Open usage settings to check your allowance and remaining quota.

youtube.title: YouTube membership
youtube.summary: Eligible Pro includes Premium Lite for one person. Both eligible Ultra tiers include Premium Family with YouTube Music Premium.
youtube.eligibility: Available in supported regions. Pro is for eligible paid plan managers. When the family manager buys Ultra, up to five other household members can share Premium.
steps: Check the YouTube membership tier on Google One benefits with the subscribed account.
Pro activates Lite automatically when eligible. Trials must convert to paid first. Check any existing standalone YouTube membership.
Ultra family managers can check sharing in their family group. Confirm the active tier in YouTube Purchases and memberships.
In some regions, Pro members can buy a discounted full YouTube Premium add-on. Check Google One benefits for the price and availability.

family.title: Family sharing
family.summary: Manage family members and available sharing options in Google One.
family.eligibility: Sharing rules vary by product. Verify any plan manager requirements for Colab and Google Cloud credits.
steps: Open Google One settings with the plan manager account and view family sharing.
Check family group members and review the sharing rules on each benefits card.

home.title: Google Home Premium
home.summary: Eligible Pro accounts can activate Standard, and eligible Ultra accounts can activate Advanced.
home.eligibility: Check eligible regions and compatible devices on the Google One benefits card.
steps: Open Google One benefits with the subscription account to find Google Home Premium activation and linked devices.

health.title: Google Health Premium
health.summary: Eligible Pro and Ultra accounts can activate Google Health Premium.
health.eligibility: The official benefits page lists account, region, and device requirements, such as a Pixel Watch or Fitbit.
steps: Find Google Health Premium in Google One benefits and verify the account and device before completing activation.

ai-studio.title: Google AI Studio web allowances
ai-studio.summary: Get more usage in the AI Studio web app for models, prototyping and image generation.
ai-studio.eligibility: Requires an eligible region and age 18+. Gemini API usage follows the selected project's billing settings.
steps: Open AI Studio with the subscribed account to check its model picker and allowance.

search-ai-mode.title: AI Mode in Google Search
search-ai-mode.summary: Get higher limits for AI Mode models and image tools, depending on the plan.
search-ai-mode.eligibility: Models and features vary by region. Agentic features in AI Mode are available in the US.
steps: Open AI Mode with the subscribed account to check the available models and features.
In the US, use Google Search in English to check for the Have AI check pricing option on local business results.

gemini-google-apps.title: Gemini in Gmail, Docs and Vids
gemini-google-apps.summary: Use Gemini to write, summarize or create content in Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Vids and other Google apps.
gemini-google-apps.eligibility: For personal Google AI plans. Features vary by language, region, age and app version.
steps: Sign in to the relevant Google app with the subscribed account and look for its Gemini control.

gmail-ai-inbox.title: Gmail AI Inbox
gmail-ai-inbox.summary: See a summary of to-dos and priority topics in Gmail.
gmail-ai-inbox.eligibility: Available in the US in English. Requires Workspace smart features.
steps: Open Gmail on a computer with the eligible account and check the sidebar for AI Inbox.

android-studio.title: Gemini in Android Studio
android-studio.summary: Get higher limits for advanced Gemini models and coding agents in Android Studio.
android-studio.eligibility: Requires a supported version of Android Studio and an eligible subscribed account.
steps: Sign in to Android Studio with the subscribed account and check models and usage in Gemini.

photos-creative.title: Google Photos creative allowances
photos-creative.summary: Get more generations for Remix and Veo photo-to-video in Google Photos.
photos-creative.eligibility: The added creative allowance on this plan page is for the US. Check availability in the supported Google Photos app.
steps: Open Create in the Google Photos app with the subscribed account and look for Remix or photo-to-video.

project-genie.title: Project Genie
project-genie.summary: Generate and explore interactive worlds from text or images.
project-genie.eligibility: Ultra 20x only. Requires age 18+ in a supported region.
steps: Open Google Labs with the Ultra 20x account to check access.

meet-premium.title: Google Meet premium features
meet-premium.summary: Eligible plans include group video calls for up to 100 participants and up to 24 hours.
meet-premium.eligibility: Host with an eligible personal account. Check the meeting controls for recording and noise cancellation.
steps: Create a meeting with the subscribed account and check which host settings are available.
Eligible Pro and Ultra accounts can also take meeting notes with Gemini. See Google Meet help for region and language requirements.

calendar-booking.title: Google Calendar premium scheduling
calendar-booking.summary: Create multiple appointment schedules and use premium options such as booking reminders.
calendar-booking.eligibility: Set up schedules on a computer with an eligible personal account. See Google Calendar for available options.
steps: In Google Calendar, select Create and then Appointment schedule to view the settings.

finance-deep-search.title: Deep Search in Google Finance
finance-deep-search.summary: Get more Deep Search queries in Google Finance according to the subscription tier.
steps: Sign in to Google Finance with the subscribed account and look for Deep Search.

chrome-auto-browse.title: Chrome auto browse
chrome-auto-browse.summary: Use Gemini auto browse in supported versions of Chrome. Limits depend on the plan.
chrome-auto-browse.eligibility: Available in the US and India. See Google Help for age, device and Chrome version requirements.
steps: Open Gemini in Chrome with the eligible account and check for the auto browse option.

playground.title: Google Playground
playground.summary: Create and play custom games with AI. Generation limits depend on the plan.
playground.eligibility: Google's plan page lists availability in the US and India. Account eligibility is shown in Playground.
steps: Sign in to Playground with the subscribed account to check its generation tools and limits.

google-store-rewards.title: Google Store rewards
google-store-rewards.summary: Earn 10% back as Google Store credit on eligible hardware and accessories. Use the credit on a future purchase.
google-store-rewards.eligibility: For eligible paid plan managers in the US, Canada, UK, Germany and Australia. Trials and family group members are excluded.
steps: Sign in to Google Store with the account that pays for Google One. Check the expected credit at checkout.
Check your Google Store credit balance after the order ships. You must still be an eligible plan manager when the credit is issued.

google-skills-credits.title: Google Skills learning credits
google-skills-credits.summary: Eligible developers receive 35 Google Skills learning credits each month for hands-on labs.
google-skills-credits.eligibility: Available with free Google Developer Program Standard membership. A developer profile and Google Cloud Innovators or eligible GEAR enrollment are required.
steps: Open My Communities & Programs in your Google Developer Program profile and join Google Cloud Innovators.
Sign in to Google Skills with the same Google account and check your learning credit balance.

developer-lab-credits.title: Developer codelab and event credits
developer-lab-credits.summary: Eligible codelabs and developer events can offer small credits to try the services featured in the activity.
developer-lab-credits.eligibility: Requires a personal Gmail account and an active developer profile. One claim per eligible activity, subject to timing, capacity and prior completions.
steps: Open the participating lab or event with your personal Developer Program account and look for its credit offer.
Follow the activity instructions within its claim window. Check the activity or your developer benefits for status.

gemini-tasks.title: Tasks in Gemini
gemini-tasks.summary: Assign multi-step tasks or schedule recurring work in Gemini. Usage limits vary by tier.
gemini-tasks.eligibility: Ages 18+. Requires a personal account and Gemini History. Free accounts can use tasks in Australia, Canada, India, Japan, South Korea and the US. Other supported regions require Pro or Ultra. The EEA, Nigeria, Switzerland and the UK currently lack access.
steps: Sign in to Gemini on the web, Mac or mobile and check the tasks controls and available usage.
Check progress and schedules in the Gemini task conversation.

google-pics.title: Google Pics
google-pics.summary: Generate and edit images on a canvas with prompts or visual references. Import assets from Drive and Google Photos.
google-pics.eligibility: Available on Pro and both Ultra tiers in supported desktop browsers. Personal accounts in Germany are excluded. Language restrictions apply to some editing tools.
steps: Open Google Pics in a desktop browser with the subscribed account and check its image generation and editing tools.

workspace-live.title: Live in Gmail, Docs and Keep
workspace-live.summary: Have a real-time voice conversation with Gemini in Gmail, Docs or Google Keep.
workspace-live.eligibility: Currently US only. Gmail Live and Docs Live are on iOS and Android. Keep Live is on iOS.
steps: Switch to the subscribed account in a supported mobile app and look for Live.

earth-gemini.title: Gemini in Google Earth
earth-gemini.summary: Use Gemini on Google Earth web to explore places, visualize boundaries and analyze maps.
earth-gemini.eligibility: Currently US web only. Google account age requirements apply. Separate usage limits for Ultra 5x and Ultra 20x are not published.
steps: Sign in to Google Earth on the web with your subscribed account and look for the Gemini analysis controls.

dreambeans.title: Dreambeans
dreambeans.summary: A Google Labs experiment that makes personalized daily stories using calendar and photo information you choose to connect.
dreambeans.eligibility: US only, ages 18+, on Android or iOS, with English support. Google One lists it in Pro help as well. The current Dreambeans enrollment guide requires Ultra and joining the waitlist.
steps: Check the current Dreambeans requirements and open the waitlist form from the official guide.

google-tv-create-hub.title: Google TV Create Hub
google-tv-create-hub.summary: Generate AI images and videos on a compatible Google TV. All three tiers get higher limits.
google-tv-create-hub.eligibility: US only, ages 18+, on Gemini-enabled TCL Google TV devices.
steps: Sign in to a supported TV with your subscribed account. Open Create Hub and follow the on-screen controls to check modes and limits.

hypothesis-generation.title: Hypothesis Generation
hypothesis-generation.summary: Google lists research hypothesis generation as an Ultra benefit. Availability depends on the account.
hypothesis-generation.eligibility: Ages 18+. Google does not publish a 5x versus 20x breakdown for this feature.
steps: Open Google One benefits with the Ultra subscriber account and check for availability.

google-one-support.title: Google One member support
google-one-support.summary: Contact Google One support about your membership, billing, features or storage.
google-one-support.eligibility: Available chat, phone and email options depend on your account and region.
steps: Open Google One support with your subscribed account and choose a contact channel.

google-one-member-offers.title: Account-specific and limited-time offers
google-one-member-offers.summary: Google may show targeted offers to eligible members on the benefits page. Open it to see what's available for your account.
google-one-member-offers.eligibility: Eligibility depends on billing region, subscription status and the offer window. Some offers are for the plan manager or limited to one claim per plan.
steps: Open Google One benefits and read the terms of each offer shown for the account.
Review redeemed offers in your benefits history.
